facts.fact: According to eMarketer, as cited by StackAdapt, the US digital ad market will surpass $300 billion by 2025.
facts.quote: the US digital ad market will surpass $300 billion by 2025, making up more than 75% of all media spending.

facts.fact: Per Statista, as cited by StackAdapt, the global video games advertising market was estimated at just over 4 billion US dollars in 2020.
facts.quote: just over 4 billion US dollars and is expected to reach 4.8 billion by 2024

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that global spending on NFTs is expected to rise to $8.3 billion in 2022, without naming a source.
facts.quote: global spending is expected to rise to $8.3 billion this year.
